latest.title: What if building an AI chatbot was as easy as building with LEGO? — AWS Blocks
latest.description:
I explored AWS Blocks by developing a chatbot with an AI agent, knowledge base (RAG), and authentication — from scratch to production.
In the article I share:

- IAM configuration with least privilege
- A region bug I found in @strands-agents/sdk (and how it was resolved)
- The full path: local development → sandbox → production with CloudFront

If you're a FullStack developer and you're interested in building applications quickly without spending too much time on infrastructure, I'm sure you'll like it

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
